factions.name: Dinas Rahasia Inggris
factions.abilityText: Sekali per game: lihat 1 kartu Bukti acak dari tangan pemain pilihanmu. Pemain lain hanya tahu kamu memakai kemampuan pada pemain itu.
factions.abilityTextEn: Once per game: look at 1 random Evidence card from a chosen player's hand. Others only learn that you used the ability on that player.

factions.name: Kantor Layanan Strategis
factions.abilityText: Pasif: menerima 250 escudo (bukan 200) setiap melewati START.
factions.abilityTextEn: Passive: collect 250 escudos (not 200) whenever passing START.

factions.name: Komisariat Rakyat Soviet
factions.abilityText: Sekali per game: saat mengajukan Dugaan, sebut 2 Tersangka sekaligus.
factions.abilityTextEn: Once per game: name 2 Suspects at once when making a Suggestion.

factions.name: Perlawanan Prancis
factions.abilityText: Sekali per game: keluar dari Penjara tanpa membayar.
factions.abilityTextEn: Once per game: leave Prison without paying.

factions.name: Pedagang Netral Portugal
factions.abilityText: Pasif: diskon 10% saat membeli properti dengan harga tertera (bukan lelang), dibulatkan ke bawah.
factions.abilityTextEn: Passive: 10% discount when buying property at list price (not auctions), rounded down.

factions.name: Jurnalis Swiss
factions.abilityText: Pasif: saat mengambil Kartu Telegram, ambil 2, jalankan 1, dan taruh yang lain di bawah tumpukan.
factions.abilityTextEn: Passive: when drawing a Telegram card, draw 2, resolve 1 and put the other on the bottom of the deck.

factions.name: Penyelundup Spanyol
factions.abilityText: Pasif: Pasar Gelap hanya 100 escudo dan tidak menambah Kecurigaan.
factions.abilityTextEn: Passive: the Black Market costs only 100 escudos and never raises Suspicion.

factions.name: Pembelot Abwehr
factions.abilityText: Pasif: mulai dengan +2 Intel dan batas Intel +2.
factions.abilityTextEn: Passive: start with +2 Intel and +2 Intel capacity.
